title: US life expectancy gap, richest vs poorest 1% by income

source.name: The Association Between Income and Life Expectancy in the United States, 2001-2014 (Chetty et al., JAMA 2016)
source.publisher: JAMA (Journal of the American Medical Association)

notes: The study's headline figures: a 14.6-year gap for men and a 10.1-year gap for women, comparing the richest 1% to the poorest 1% by household income.
